data: Which of the following models are shown in figure 10?

The caption states that Figure 10 shows cross-validation to choose the best performing model capacity for each model. The lines in the figure represent different models, and their colors correspond to the legend on the right side of the figure. The legend lists six models: MTL-Avg., STL-SST, STL-MR, STL-CR, STL-SUBJ, and STL-MPQA. Therefore, the models shown in Figure 10 are MTL-Avg., STL-SST, STL-MR, STL-CR, STL-SUBJ, and STL-MPQA.
